metric_definitions.AP: noninterpolated one-vs-rest AP with exact ties retained
metric_definitions.macro_AP_AUROC: unweighted mean of four classes; null if any class statistic undefined
metric_definitions.balanced_accuracy: mean recall of classes with positive evaluation weight
metric_definitions.NLL: float64 clipped normalized four-class log loss
metric_definitions.Brier: sum of four squared probability errors per event
metric_definitions.common_support: fixed accepted S2 coarse E/vertex weights; target Z unmatched
metric_definitions.CI95: pointwise paired block percentile interval; does not include training stochasticity
metric_definitions.training_seed_SD: sample SD across separately trained seeds; not event replication
